intro: Use short everyday texts to find a time, a price, a place or a simple instruction.
b1.texto: A short notice often gives one main piece of information: a time, place, price or rule. Read the heading and numbers first, then check the words around them. You do not need to understand every word to find a departure time or choose an item from a menu.
b3.f0: Open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00. Closed on Sundays.
b4.f0: Set menu: soup, Spanish omelette or salad. Water included. Price: 12 euros.
b5.f0: Hi, I arrive at six. I will wait for you in front of the museum.
